barriers.title: Tritium Scarcity
barriers.detail: ~25kg global supply. Lithium blanket breeding unproven at commercial scale.

barriers.title: Materials Degradation
barriers.detail: Neutron bombardment degrades structural components faster than fission. No material validated for full commercial duty cycle. EU €340M research program launched Jan 2026.

barriers.title: Timeline Slippage History
barriers.detail: ITER over $22B and years behind. Fusion timelines have historically slipped by 5-10 years across all major programs.

barriers.title: Net Energy Positive at Grid Scale
barriers.detail: NIF achieved ignition in 2022 but energy output was laser-input dependent. Commercial energy positive remains undemonstrated at utility scale.

milestone_banner.text: On September 30, 2026, TAE Technologies and Trump Media filed SEC Form S-4 advancing their proposed $6B all-stock merger, while KSTAR achieved a 48-second plasma hold at 100 million degrees and LLNL/Pacific Fusion reached 3,000 shots with their Sirius pulsed-power prototype in July 2026.

kstar.name: KSTAR
kstar.description: KSTAR achieved a 48-second plasma hold at 100 million degrees in its full tungsten environment, surpassing 20,000 total experiments. The facility continues advancing toward its 300-second plasma hold target.

cfs.name: Commonwealth Fusion
cfs.description: CFS placed largest single HTS tape order with Fujikura to accelerate ARC commercial plant development while SPARC construction continues toward 2027 first plasma. Company secured additional $1B funding round bringing total to $5B as leadership prepares for Disrupt 2026 appearance.

helion.name: Helion Energy
helion.description: Helion has shifted its first power timeline according to September 2026 reports, while setting a temperature record. Company cleared US regulatory licenses in June 2026 and continues OpenAI power deal negotiations alongside Microsoft PPA.

tae.name: TAE Technologies / TMTG
tae.description: TAE Technologies and Trump Media filed Form S-4 registration statement with SEC on September 30, 2026, advancing the proposed $6B all-stock merger. Trump retains significant ownership interest in combined entity per regulatory filing disclosures.

iter.name: ITER
iter.description: ITER achieves regulatory milestone with vacuum vessel exemption from fission-based regulation while sixth tokamak sector module installation completes. Breeding blanket and tritium plant plans advance as project reports substantial summer progress toward 2027 first plasma.

east.name: EAST / China Program
east.description: EAST tokamak exceeded the Greenwald density limit in January 2026, achieving plasma densities previously considered theoretically impossible. China maintains global leadership in high-density sustained plasma research under its $1.5B 14th Five-Year Plan fusion program.
